program_name: HEC Need Based Scholarships Program
program_name_ur: ایچ ای سی ضرورت مند اسکالرشپ پروگرام
implementing_agency: Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan
target_beneficiary: Economically disadvantaged undergraduate students admitted on merit in public sector universities
special_criteria: Regular morning admission in participating public university; merit standing; verified financial hardship
benefits_coverage: 100% Tuition fee coverage + PKR 6,000/month living stipend for standard degree duration
required_documents: Applicant CNIC/B-Form; Guardian CNIC; Salary slip/income affidavit; 6-month utility bills; Semester fee challan; Academic transcripts; Rent agreement (if rented)
application_steps: Apply online via HEC Scholarship Portal (eportal.hec.gov.pk) or through University Financial Aid Office (FAO). Shortlisted applicants are interviewed by ISAC committee.

program_name: Prime Minister's Youth Laptop Scheme (PMYLS)
program_name_ur: وزیراعظم یوتھ لیپ ٹاپ اسکیم
implementing_agency: Prime Minister's Youth Programme (PMYP) & HEC
target_beneficiary: Regular students enrolled in HEC-recognized public higher education institutions
special_criteria: Active student in approved degree; allocation based strictly on CGPA/percentage merit quota; private/distance excluded
benefits_coverage: Free brand new high-end core-spec laptop equipped with licensed OS and academic software
required_documents: Valid CNIC / B-Form; University Student ID card; Institutional bonafide verification; Transcript showing latest semester CGPA or terminal percentage
application_steps: Apply online on PMYP Students Portal (pmyp.gov.pk). Institutional focal persons verify academic data before final merit list generation.

program_name: HEC Indigenous PhD Fellowship Program
program_name_ur: ایچ ای سی مقامی پی ایچ ڈی فیلوشپ پروگرام
implementing_agency: Higher Education Commission (HEC)
target_beneficiary: Pakistani/AJK nationals with outstanding academic credentials pursuing full-time PhD in Pakistan
special_criteria: Minimum 16 years of education with 1st Division / 3.0 CGPA; valid HAT or equivalent HEC aptitude test score; no other full scholarship
benefits_coverage: Monthly stipend of PKR 25,000 - 35,000 + full tuition fee + book & thesis allowance
required_documents: CNIC; Educational degrees from Matric to MS; Equivalence (if foreign); HAT score card; Research proposal; Enrolment certificate
application_steps: Submit online via HEC portal (eportal.hec.gov.pk) during advertised call for proposals.

program_name: Workers Welfare Fund (WWF) National Higher Education Scholarship
program_name_ur: ورکرز ویلفیئر فنڈ قومی اعلیٰ تعلیمی اسکالرشپ
implementing_agency: Workers Welfare Fund (WWF), Ministry of Overseas Pakistanis & HRD
target_beneficiary: Children of industrial workers registered under EOBI or Social Security (SESSI/PESSI)
special_criteria: Parent must be a registered industrial worker with at least 3 years verified service; student admitted on merit
benefits_coverage: 100% Tuition fee, hostel fee, transport charges, and monthly transport/pocket allowance
required_documents: Worker EOBI card / Social Security card; Worker service certificate; Student CNIC/B-Form; Admission letter; Fee challan; Character certificate
application_steps: Submit application attested by factory/mill employer to Provincial Workers Welfare Board or Directorate.

program_name: Overseas Pakistanis Foundation (OPF) Educational Scholarship
program_name_ur: اوورسیز پاکستانیز فاؤنڈیشن تعلیمی اسکالرشپ
implementing_agency: Overseas Pakistanis Foundation (OPF)
target_beneficiary: Children of registered overseas Pakistani workers studying in Intermediate, Graduate, or Professional programs
special_criteria: Father/Mother must be a registered overseas worker holding valid OPF membership or Protector stamp; minimum 60% marks
benefits_coverage: Annual educational grant ranging from PKR 30,000 to PKR 50,000 per academic year
required_documents: OPF membership card copy; Foreign work visa/passport page; Student CNIC/B-form; Last exam marksheet; Fee voucher
application_steps: Apply online through OPF education portal (opf.org.pk) during annual cycle.

program_name: National Endowment Scholarships for Talent (NEST) - Nursing & Undergraduate
program_name_ur: قومی اینڈومنٹ اسکالرشپ فار ٹیلنٹ (نسٹ)
implementing_agency: National Endowment Scholarships for Talent (NEST), Ministry of Federal Education
target_beneficiary: Needy and talented students admitted in BS Nursing, Fine Arts, and STEM programs in partner universities
special_criteria: Admission secured on merit; special focus on nursing students and vulnerable districts across Pakistan
benefits_coverage: Full admission and tuition fees + PKR 5,000 monthly living stipend
required_documents: CNIC/B-Form; Guardian CNIC; Income certificate; Intermediate certificate; Institutional admission proof; Domicile
application_steps: Apply through partner institution's Financial Aid Office or online when NEST opens calls.

program_name: HEC Undergraduate Scholarship for Gilgit-Baltistan Students
program_name_ur: ایچ ای سی انڈرگریجویٹ اسکالرشپ برائے طلبہ گلگت بلتستان
implementing_agency: Higher Education Commission (HEC)
target_beneficiary: Students having domicile/local certificate of Gilgit-Baltistan pursuing 4-5 year BS degrees in top Pakistani universities
special_criteria: Domicile of Gilgit-Baltistan; completed SSC/HSSC in GB; qualified HEC aptitude aptitude test (ETC)
benefits_coverage: Tuition fee waiver up to PKR 240,000/year + annual book allowance + monthly stipend of PKR 15,000
required_documents: GB Domicile/Local Certificate; SSC & HSSC Result Cards; CNIC/B-Form; HEC ETC test roll number slip
application_steps: Register via HEC Education Testing Council (etc.hec.gov.pk) and eportal.

program_name: HEC Scholarship Scheme for Students of Balochistan and Former FATA
program_name_ur: ایچ ای سی اسکالرشپ اسکیم برائے طلبہ بلوچستان و سابقہ فاٹا
implementing_agency: Higher Education Commission (HEC)
target_beneficiary: Undergraduate and postgraduate students holding domicile of Balochistan or erstwhile FATA tribal districts
special_criteria: Valid Domicile/Local Certificate of Balochistan or Former FATA; passed intermediate or 16-year degree; aptitude test clearance
benefits_coverage: 100% Tuition fees, hostel charges, books allowance (PKR 30,000/year) and monthly stipend (PKR 18,000 - 24,000)
required_documents: Local/Domicile Certificate; Father CNIC; Academic degrees; Medical fitness certificate; HEC ETC roll slip
application_steps: Apply online at HEC e-portal when applications are invited by Project Directorate.

program_name: NAVTTC Prime Minister's Youth Skills Development Program (PMYSDP)
program_name_ur: نیوٹیک وزیراعظم یوتھ اسکل ڈیولپمنٹ پروگرام
implementing_agency: National Vocational and Technical Training Commission (NAVTTC)
target_beneficiary: Unemployed youth seeking marketable digital and high-tech industrial vocational skills (IT, AI, Robotics, Trades)
special_criteria: Pakistani citizen; priority given to underprivileged youth, school dropouts, and women
benefits_coverage: Free 3-to-6-month technical training + internationally recognized NAVTTC certificate + monthly stipend + toolkit
required_documents: Valid CNIC / B-Form; Educational certificates (Matric/FA/FSc or higher if applying for Hi-Tech); Passport size photograph
application_steps: Register online through NAVTTC National Skills Portal (nsis.navttc.gov.pk) or candidate portal.

program_name: Benazir Kafaalat Programme (BISP)
program_name_ur: بے نظیر کفالت پروگرام
implementing_agency: Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP), Government of Pakistan
target_beneficiary: Female heads of low-income households falling below the national poverty line
special_criteria: Ever-married female; NSER PMT score <= 32; no family ownership of commercial land, luxury vehicle, or foreign travel
benefits_coverage: Unconditional quarterly cash grant of PKR 10,500 to PKR 13,500 disbursed through biometric ATM/campsites
required_documents: Original CNIC of female head; NADRA B-Forms for children; Biometric verification; Registered mobile SIM
application_steps: Undergo dynamic registry survey at nearest BISP Tehsil Center. Verify eligibility by texting CNIC to 8171.

program_name: Benazir Taleemi Wazaif Programme
program_name_ur: بے نظیر تعلیمی وظائف پروگرام
implementing_agency: Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP)
target_beneficiary: School and college-going children (aged 4-22) of active Benazir Kafaalat beneficiary mothers
special_criteria: Mother must be an active registered BISP recipient; child must maintain minimum 70% school attendance per quarter
benefits_coverage: Quarterly cash stipend (Primary: PKR 1,500-2,000; Secondary: PKR 2,500-3,000; Higher Secondary: PKR 3,500-4,000) + PKR 3,000 primary bonus for girls
required_documents: Mother's CNIC; Child's NADRA B-Form/CRC; School Admission/Attendance verification slip stamped by headteacher
application_steps: Obtain school enrollment slip, get stamped by school head, submit at nearest BISP Tehsil Registration Office.

program_name: Benazir Nashonuma Programme
program_name_ur: بے نظیر نشوونما پروگرام
implementing_agency: BISP in partnership with World Food Programme (WFP) & Health Departments
target_beneficiary: Pregnant & Lactating Women (PLW) and children under 24 months from underprivileged households
special_criteria: Must be enrolled in BISP Kafaalat; compliance with compulsory health checkups, maternal nutrition sessions, and EPI child vaccinations
benefits_coverage: Quarterly cash stipend (PKR 2,000 for mother/male infant; PKR 2,500 for female infant) + free Specialized Nutritious Food (SNF) sachets
required_documents: Mother's CNIC; Child's NADRA B-Form / Birth Certificate; Child Immunization Card; Antenatal/Postnatal medical booklet
application_steps: Visit dedicated Nashonuma Facilitation Centers located at District and Tehsil Headquarters (DHQ/THQ) Hospitals.

program_name: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Individual Financial Assistance (IFA General)
program_name_ur: پاکستان بیت المال انفرادی مالی امداد (عام)
implementing_agency: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal (PBM)
target_beneficiary: Destitute individuals, widows, orphans, disabled persons, and poverty-stricken citizens facing urgent hardship
special_criteria: Total monthly family income must not exceed PKR 74,000; applicant must not have availed similar assistance from PBM in same fiscal year
benefits_coverage: One-time or emergency rehabilitation grant up to PKR 60,000 per family for basic sustenance, sewing machines, or toolkits
required_documents: Application written on plain paper addressed to MD PBM; Valid copy of applicant CNIC; Family CNICs/B-Forms; Attested income certificate; Affidavit
application_steps: Submit application dossier to local District Bait-ul-Mal Office or apply online through pbm.gov.pk.

program_name: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal IFA - Education Stipends
program_name_ur: پاکستان بیت المال تعلیمی وظائف
implementing_agency: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal (PBM)
target_beneficiary: Needy and non-affording regular students studying in government institutions and universities
special_criteria: Enrolled in public sector college/university; passing grades; family monthly income <= PKR 74,000; first-come, first-served
benefits_coverage: Annual educational fee payment made directly to the university/college accounting head
required_documents: PBM Bonafide certificate filled by college/university head; Applicant CNIC; Father CNIC; Fee structure challan; Income affidavit
application_steps: Submit PBM educational application endorsed by the university head/focal person to the nearest PBM regional office.

program_name: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal IFA - Persons with Disabilities (Rehabilitation)
program_name_ur: پاکستان بیت المال بحالی برائے معذور افراد
implementing_agency: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal (PBM)
target_beneficiary: Persons with physical disabilities, hearing impairment, visual impairment, or mobility restrictions
special_criteria: Special disability CNIC (wheelchair logo) or disability assessment board certificate; family income <= PKR 74,000
benefits_coverage: Free motorized/manual wheelchairs, customized hearing aids, white canes, artificial limbs, and tri-cycles
required_documents: Disability certificate issued by National/Provincial Council for Rehabilitation of Disabled Persons (N/PCRDP); CNIC copy; Photographs
application_steps: Submit request at District PBM Office with disability medical board certificate.

program_name: Workers Welfare Fund (WWF) Marriage Grant
program_name_ur: ورکرز ویلفیئر فنڈ میرج گرانٹ
implementing_agency: Workers Welfare Fund (WWF)
target_beneficiary: Registered industrial workers for the marriage of their daughters (or female workers themselves)
special_criteria: Worker registered with EOBI or Social Security with minimum 3 years employment in an industrial establishment
benefits_coverage: One-time cash financial grant of PKR 400,000 per daughter's wedding (up to multiple daughters)
required_documents: Worker EOBI/Social Security card; Factory registration certificate; Nikahnama (marriage contract); NADRA CNIC of bride & groom; Attestation by employer
application_steps: Submit application through factory employer to Provincial Workers Welfare Board.

program_name: Workers Welfare Fund (WWF) Death Grant
program_name_ur: ورکرز ویلفیئر فنڈ ڈیتھ گرانٹ
implementing_agency: Workers Welfare Fund (WWF)
target_beneficiary: Legal heirs and surviving families of deceased industrial workers
special_criteria: Deceased was a registered worker with at least 6 months insurable service; natural or accidental death
benefits_coverage: Lump-sum financial grant of PKR 800,000 paid to surviving legal heirs / widow
required_documents: Death certificate from NADRA; Union Council burial certificate; EOBI card of deceased; Legal heir certificate; Widow CNIC
application_steps: Submit claim dossier through employer to the respective Provincial Workers Welfare Board office.

program_name: Employees' Old-Age Benefits Institution (EOBI) Old-Age Pension
program_name_ur: ای او بی آئی بڑھاپا پنشن
implementing_agency: Employees' Old-Age Benefits Institution (EOBI)
target_beneficiary: Retired insured employees from private sector commercial and industrial establishments
special_criteria: Attained age 60 (male) or 55 (female/mine worker); minimum 15 years insurable paid employment contributions
benefits_coverage: Lifetime monthly pension of PKR 10,000 - 15,000+ disbursed via Bank of Punjab / Allied Bank EOBI wallet
required_documents: EOBI Registration Card (PI-02); Original CNIC; Proof of employment & contributions (Form PR-03); Bank account details
application_steps: Submit Claim Form (PI-03) at nearest EOBI Regional Office upon attaining retirement age.

program_name: Employees' Old-Age Benefits Institution (EOBI) Survivor's Pension
program_name_ur: ای او بی آئی بیوہ / پسماندگان پنشن
implementing_agency: Employees' Old-Age Benefits Institution (EOBI)
target_beneficiary: Surviving widows, minor orphans, and dependent parents of deceased insured employees or pensioners
special_criteria: Deceased worker possessed minimum 36 months insurable service or was an active EOBI pensioner
benefits_coverage: Lifetime monthly pension equal to 100% of the deceased insured person's full pension rate
required_documents: NADRA Death certificate; Deceased EOBI card; Widow's CNIC; Nikahnama; Family Registration Certificate (FRC)
application_steps: Submit Survivor Claim Form (PI-04) at the EOBI Regional Office handling the deceased worker's file.

program_name: Prime Minister's Youth Business & Agriculture Loan Scheme (PMYB&ALS)
program_name_ur: وزیراعظم یوتھ بزنس و زرعی قرضہ اسکیم
implementing_agency: Prime Minister's Youth Programme (PMYP) in collaboration with SBP & Commercial Banks
target_beneficiary: Aspiring young entrepreneurs, startups, small business owners, and youth farmers
special_criteria: Pakistani citizen; viable business proposal; clean credit record (e-CIB). Tier-1 loans up to PKR 500,000 are interest-free (0% markup)
benefits_coverage: Subsidized loans: Tier 1 (up to PKR 500k at 0%), Tier 2 (PKR 500k-1.5M at 5%), Tier 3 (PKR 1.5M-7.5M at 7%)
required_documents: Valid CNIC; Business plan / feasibility summary; Proof of educational/technical qualification; Utility bill; Personal guarantor (for T2/T3)
application_steps: Submit online application exclusively through the official PMYP portal (pmyp.gov.pk).

program_name: OPF Financial Assistance for Deceased Overseas Pakistanis
program_name_ur: اوورسیز پاکستانیز فاؤنڈیشن مالی امداد برائے متوفی اوورسیز ملازمین
implementing_agency: Overseas Pakistanis Foundation (OPF)
target_beneficiary: Destitute dependents and legal heirs of registered overseas Pakistani workers who pass away abroad
special_criteria: Deceased worker registered with Protector of Emigrants; death occurred abroad during active legal work contract
benefits_coverage: One-time financial assistance grant of PKR 400,000 to family + free dead-body transportation service from airport
required_documents: Death Certificate from foreign hospital/embassy; Passport showing Protector Stamp; Heirship certificate; Widow/Heir CNIC
application_steps: Submit formal request at OPF Head Office in Islamabad or regional offices in Lahore, Karachi, Peshawar, Quetta, Mirpur.

program_name: Qaumi Sehat Sahulat Program / Sehat Sahulat Program
program_name_ur: قومی صحت سہولت پروگرام
province: ICT Islamabad, AJK, Gilgit-Baltistan, designated federal zones
implementing_agency: Ministry of National Health Services, Regulations & Coordination & State Life
target_beneficiary: All permanent resident families in designated zones and NSER low-income registered households
special_criteria: Valid CNIC registered in NADRA family tree (FRC); designated territorial residency or NSER health poverty score
benefits_coverage: Cashless indoor hospitalization up to PKR 1,000,000 per family/year covering secondary care and priority tertiary diseases (cardiovascular, oncology, dialysis, surgical procedures, ICU)
required_documents: Original NADRA CNIC of patient / family head; NADRA B-Form for minors; Family Registration Certificate (FRC); Hospital admission referral slip
application_steps: Check eligibility by sending 13-digit CNIC to 8500 SMS or online at pmhealthprogram.gov.pk. Present CNIC directly at Sehat Sahulat counter in empanelled hospital.

program_name: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal IFA - Medical Treatment Grant
program_name_ur: پاکستان بیت المال علاج معالجہ مالی امداد
implementing_agency: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal (PBM)
target_beneficiary: Impoverished patients suffering from life-threatening critical illnesses (Cancer, Cardiac, Dialysis, Organ Surgeries)
special_criteria: Admitted in an empanelled public sector tertiary hospital; monthly household income <= PKR 74,000
benefits_coverage: Financial coverage up to PKR 1,500,000 paid directly to the treating public hospital for surgeries/medicines (up to PKR 2.15M for cochlear implants)
required_documents: Medical requisition estimate from treating hospital specialist; Original diagnostic reports; Patient CNIC/B-Form; Family CNICs; Attested income certificate
application_steps: Submit medical dossier endorsed by Medical Superintendent (MS) of treating hospital to local District PBM Office.

program_name: Chief Minister Punjab Honhaar Undergraduate Scholarship Program
program_name_ur: وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب ہونہار انڈرگریجویٹ اسکالرشپ پروگرام
implementing_agency: Higher Education Department (HED) Punjab / Punjab Higher Education Commission
target_beneficiary: Meritorious students admitted into 4-5 year BS, MBBS, and BDS programs across 68 priority disciplines
special_criteria: Punjab domicile holder; minimum 60% in Intermediate/HSSC; family monthly income <= PKR 300,000; enrolled in approved public or designated top private universities
benefits_coverage: 100% full tuition fee coverage directly paid to university for the complete degree duration (4 to 5 years)
required_documents: Applicant's CNIC / B-Form; Father / Guardian's CNIC; Punjab Domicile Certificate; Intermediate Mark Sheet; University admission offer letter; Income affidavit on stamp paper
application_steps: Apply online via official portal: honhaarscholarship.punjabhec.gov.pk during annual admission cycle.

program_name: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF) Undergraduate Scholarship
program_name_ur: پنجاب ایجوکیشنل اینڈومنٹ فنڈ (پیف) انڈرگریجویٹ اسکالرشپ
implementing_agency: The Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF), Govt of Punjab
target_beneficiary: Deserving and talented students from Punjab who completed Intermediate and enrolled in higher education
special_criteria: Minimum 60% marks in Intermediate examination from Punjab BISE; monthly family income <= PKR 60,000 (BPS 1-4 govt employees exempt)
benefits_coverage: Full tuition fees + monthly stipend (day-scholar PKR 3,000/mo, boarder PKR 5,000/mo) throughout academic program
required_documents: PEEF Scholarship Form; Applicant CNIC / B-Form; Father/Guardian CNIC; Domicile certificate; Intermediate result card; Semester fee challan; Salary slip/affidavit
application_steps: Submit application online on PEEF Student Portal (student.peef.org.pk) or through University Financial Aid Office.

program_name: PEEF Special Quota Scholarship (Orphans, Minorities, Disabled, BPS 1-4)
program_name_ur: پیف خصوصی کوٹہ اسکالرشپ
implementing_agency: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF)
target_beneficiary: Vulnerable category students: Orphan children, Religious minorities, Persons with Disabilities, Children of Grade 1-4 Govt employees
special_criteria: Passed Matric or Inter with >=60% from Punjab BISE; relevant quota certification (Death cert of father, disability cert, minority NADRA proof, BPS 1-4 pay slip)
benefits_coverage: Complete institutional tuition fee + monthly pocket stipend
required_documents: Special Quota application form; Disability certificate or Death certificate of father; Pay slip of parent (for BPS 1-4); Domicile; Result card
application_steps: Apply directly online via PEEF Special Quota registration page (student.peef.org.pk/specialquotaRegistration).

program_name: PEEF Master's Level Scholarship
program_name_ur: پیف ماسٹرز لیول اسکالرشپ
implementing_agency: Punjab Educational Endowment Fund (PEEF)
target_beneficiary: High-achieving students admitted in Master's degree (MA, MSc, MS) in partner public universities in Punjab
special_criteria: Minimum 60% marks or 2.5 CGPA in Graduation examination held in last 3 years; Punjab domicile; admitted on merit in morning session
benefits_coverage: 100% tuition fees + monthly stipend (PKR 3,000/month day scholar, PKR 5,000/month boarder)
required_documents: Graduation degree & marksheet; Admission proof in partner university; Domicile; Income certificate / salary slip; CNIC
application_steps: Apply directly through the Financial Aid Office / Focal Person of the participating public university.

program_name: TEVTA Punjab Free Technical Training Courses
program_name_ur: ٹیوٹا پنجاب مفت تکنیکی تربیتی کورسز
implementing_agency: Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (TEVTA) Punjab
target_beneficiary: Youth seeking technical skills in trades, computer applications, industrial arts, automotive, and emerging technologies
special_criteria: Resident of Punjab; minimum education criteria varies by course (Middle to Matric/Inter)
benefits_coverage: Free training + free course material/tool usage + TEVTA certification recognized domestically and in Gulf countries + monthly stipend in selected courses
required_documents: Copy of CNIC or B-Form; Educational certificates (Matric/Middle); Two passport size photographs
application_steps: Apply online at tevta.gop.pk or visit local TEVTA college / vocational training institute.

program_name: Punjab Skills Development Fund (PSDF) Free Skills Training
program_name_ur: پنجاب اسکلز ڈیولپمنٹ فنڈ (پی ایس ڈی ایف) مفت ہنر پروگرام
implementing_agency: Punjab Skills Development Fund (PSDF)
target_beneficiary: Underprivileged youth in Punjab seeking high-demand skills in IT, digital freelancing, garments, agriculture, and services
special_criteria: Permanent domicile of Punjab; priority to poor and marginalized districts
benefits_coverage: 100% free tuition + subsidized transport stipend (approx PKR 1,500 - 3,000/mo) + accredited certification + job placement support
required_documents: Valid CNIC; Educational transcripts; Proof of residence in Punjab
application_steps: Enroll online through PSDF website (psdf.org.pk) during course admission rounds.

program_name: Punjab Social Protection Authority (PSPA) Ba-Himmat Buzurg Program
program_name_ur: پنجاب باہمت بزرگ پروگرام
implementing_agency: Punjab Social Protection Authority (PSPA), Govt of Punjab
target_beneficiary: Vulnerable senior citizens (aged 65+) in Punjab residing in households not covered by BISP
special_criteria: Age 65+ confirmed via NADRA CNIC; resident of Punjab; NSER poverty score <= 30; preference given to elderly women; exclusive to households not enrolled in BISP Kafaalat
benefits_coverage: Monthly cash pension of PKR 2,000 disbursed via Bank of Punjab biometric branchless banking card/ATM
required_documents: Original NADRA CNIC showing verified date of birth (65+); Proof of Punjab domicile / permanent residential address; Active personal mobile SIM card
application_steps: Beneficiaries identified automatically through NSER database. Inquiries and biometric onboarding available at Bank of Punjab or PSPA facilitation desks.

program_name: PSPA Humqadam Program for Persons with Disabilities
program_name_ur: ہم قدم پروگرام برائے معذور افراد پنجاب
implementing_agency: Punjab Social Protection Authority (PSPA)
target_beneficiary: Persons with severe disabilities holding special NADRA CNIC living in low-income families
special_criteria: Possession of Special CNIC or B-Form with disability logo issued by NADRA; NSER PMT score <= 30
benefits_coverage: Monthly unconditional cash assistance of PKR 2,000 disbursed through Bank of Punjab biometric accounts
required_documents: Special CNIC/B-Form with disability symbol; Disability certificate from District Assessment Board; Punjab residential proof
application_steps: Get evaluated by District Assessment Board for disability, obtain special CNIC from NADRA, verify enrollment at PSPA / BoP branch.

program_name: Punjab Himmat Card Scheme (Social Welfare Department)
program_name_ur: پنجاب ہمت کارڈ اسکیم
implementing_agency: Social Welfare & Bait-ul-Maal Department, Government of the Punjab
target_beneficiary: Certified Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) who are not fit to work and lack financial support
special_criteria: Registered as disabled in Disability Persons Management Information System (DPMIS); Punjab domicile; not employed in govt/private firm
benefits_coverage: Quarterly stipend of PKR 10,500 disbursed via designated Bank of Punjab Himmat ATM Card + provision of assistive devices
required_documents: Special CNIC with wheelchair insignia; DPMIS registration number; Punjab domicile certificate; Medical board assessment certificate
application_steps: Register on the Punjab DPMIS portal (dpmis.punjab.gov.pk) and collect card from designated Bank of Punjab branches.

program_name: PSPA Nayee Zindagi Program (Acid Burn Victims Rehabilitation)
program_name_ur: نئی زندگی پروگرام برائے متاثرین تیزاب گردی
implementing_agency: Punjab Social Protection Authority (PSPA)
target_beneficiary: Victims of acid burn attacks residing in Punjab
special_criteria: Victim of acid crime in Punjab; FIR / Medico-legal report (MLC) verified by police and health department
benefits_coverage: Free medical and reconstructive surgery + psychological counseling + legal aid + monthly subsistence stipend + vocational training
required_documents: Copy of FIR; Medico-Legal Certificate (MLC); Patient CNIC/B-Form; Hospital medical records
application_steps: Contact PSPA Helpdesk 1221 or visit PSPA counter at major tertiary burn units in Lahore, Multan, or Faisalabad.

program_name: Chief Minister Punjab Kissan Card Scheme
program_name_ur: وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب کسان کارڈ اسکیم
implementing_agency: Agriculture Department Punjab in collaboration with Bank of Punjab
target_beneficiary: Small and medium agricultural farmers cultivating land up to 12.5 acres in Punjab
special_criteria: Land ownership verified through Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA); clean credit history; registered SIM on CNIC
benefits_coverage: Interest-free agricultural loans up to PKR 150,000 per crop season for subsidized fertilizer, seeds, and agrochemicals via digital wallet
required_documents: Valid CNIC; PLRA land ownership fard/khatuni; Biometric SIM card; Mobile phone
application_steps: Send CNIC to 8070 via SMS or apply at nearest Punjab Land Record Center (Arazi Record Center) or BoP branch.

program_name: Chief Minister Punjab Green Tractor Scheme
program_name_ur: وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب گرین ٹریکٹر اسکیم
implementing_agency: Agriculture Department, Government of Punjab
target_beneficiary: Farmers owning between 1 to 50 acres of agricultural land in Punjab
special_criteria: Permanent resident of Punjab; verified agricultural land ownership; selection via transparent electronic balloting
benefits_coverage: Government subsidy of PKR 1,000,000 (10 Lakh) per tractor on purchase of approved local tractors
required_documents: Valid CNIC; Land ownership certificate verified by PLRA; Affidavit agreeing not to sell tractor for 3 years
application_steps: Submit online application through official Punjab Agriculture portal (agripunjab.gov.pk) during balloting registration window.

program_name: Punjab Bait-ul-Mal Guzara Allowance
program_name_ur: پنجاب بیت المال گزارہ الاؤنس
implementing_agency: Social Welfare & Bait-ul-Maal Department, Government of Punjab
target_beneficiary: Needy widows, disabled persons, and indigent citizens residing permanently in Punjab
special_criteria: Must be certified as Mustahiq (deserving) by the District Bait-ul-Mal Committee; not in receipt of other pensions
benefits_coverage: Financial grant of PKR 1,500 to PKR 2,000 per month disbursed through local post offices or bank accounts
required_documents: Application form; Copy of CNIC; Death certificate of husband (for widows); Disability certificate (if applicable); Two references
application_steps: Apply through District Officer Social Welfare / District Bait-ul-Mal Committee in respective district.

program_name: Sindh Educational Endowment Fund (SEEF) Scholarship
program_name_ur: سندھ ایجوکیشنل اینڈومنٹ فنڈ (سیف) اسکالرشپ
implementing_agency: College Education Department, Government of Sindh
target_beneficiary: Deserving and talented students holding Sindh domicile enrolled in higher education institutions
special_criteria: Sindh Domicile & PRC (Form C); enrolled in approved institutions in Medicine, Engineering, IT, Agriculture, Law, Business; minimum 60% or 2.5 CGPA; verified financial hardship
benefits_coverage: 100% tuition fee and mandatory institutional charges paid directly to approved university for the academic year
required_documents: Applicant CNIC / B-Form; Father/Guardian CNIC; Sindh Domicile and PRC (Form C); Previous semester transcript; University enrollment certificate; Income certificate / pay slip; Utility bills
application_steps: Apply online at SEEF portal (seef.sindh.gov.pk) and submit hard copy dossier with attached documentation to the University Financial Aid Office.

program_name: Sindh Higher Education Commission (SHEC) Indigenous Scholarships
program_name_ur: سندھ ایچ ای سی مقامی اسکالرشپ
implementing_agency: Sindh Higher Education Commission (SHEC)
target_beneficiary: Meritorious postgraduate and doctoral scholars pursuing research in public universities in Sindh
special_criteria: Sindh Domicile; enrolled in HEC-recognized public university in Sindh; clear aptitude test and research proposal review
benefits_coverage: Full tuition fees + monthly stipend of PKR 25,000 for PhD scholars + thesis defense funding
required_documents: Domicile & PRC; Academic degrees from Matric to MS; Research synopsis approved by Advanced Studies Board (ASRB); CNIC
application_steps: Apply through SHEC online portal (shec.sindh.gov.pk) or through university directorate of research.

program_name: STEVTA Sindh Free Technical Training & Vocational Education
program_name_ur: سندھ ٹیوٹا مفت تکنیکی و پیشہ ورانہ تربیت
implementing_agency: Sindh Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (STEVTA)
target_beneficiary: Youth in Sindh seeking practical employment skills in electrical, mechanical, IT, fashion design, and healthcare trades
special_criteria: Resident of Sindh holding CNIC/B-Form; basic literacy or Matric depending on course tier
benefits_coverage: Free training + tool usage + Sindh Board of Technical Education (SBTE) certification + stipend in donor-funded tracks
required_documents: CNIC/B-Form; Educational certificates; 2 passport photos; Sindh domicile (if required)
application_steps: Visit nearest STEVTA Vocational Training Institute (VTI) or polytechnic institute in Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, etc.

program_name: Sindh Peoples Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF) Reconstruction Grant
program_name_ur: سندھ پیپلز ہاؤسنگ برائے سیلاب متاثرین گرانٹ
implementing_agency: Sindh Peoples Housing for Flood Affectees (SPHF), Government of Sindh
target_beneficiary: Families whose houses were completely destroyed or severely damaged during devastating floods in Sindh
special_criteria: House damage verified through geo-tagged satellite/field survey; land title registered in woman head's name
benefits_coverage: Direct cash grant of up to PKR 300,000 transferred in tranches into beneficiary bank/microfinance account for resilient house construction
required_documents: NADRA CNIC of female head/applicant; Geo-tagged damage survey token; Proof of land ownership/certificate
application_steps: Identified through door-to-door SPHF survey and verified at SPHF district facilitation centers.

program_name: Sindh Social Protection Authority (SSPA) Mother & Child Support Program
program_name_ur: سندھ سوشل پروٹیکشن اتھارٹی ماں اور بچہ سپورٹ پروگرام
implementing_agency: Sindh Social Protection Authority (SSPA), Government of Sindh
target_beneficiary: Pregnant and lactating mothers living in selected vulnerable rural districts of Sindh
special_criteria: Resident of target rural districts in Sindh; attending mandatory prenatal, postnatal, and institutional birth services
benefits_coverage: Cash transfers up to PKR 30,000 phased across pregnancy, institutional delivery, birth registration, and 1,000 days growth monitoring
required_documents: Mother's CNIC; Health center maternal passport / ANC card; Child birth registration certificate
application_steps: Register at rural basic health units (BHUs) or Tehsil hospitals equipped with SSPA registration desks.

program_name: Sindh Zakat & Ushr Department Guzara Allowance
program_name_ur: سندھ زکوٰۃ و عشر گزارہ الاؤنس
implementing_agency: Zakat and Ushr Department, Government of Sindh
target_beneficiary: Needy Muslims, poor widows, disabled individuals, and orphans residing in Sindh
special_criteria: Muslim faith; certified as Mustahiq-e-Zakat by Local Zakat Committee (LZC); not receiving other regular government pensions
benefits_coverage: Monthly cash stipend of PKR 1,500 - 2,000 disbursed through mobile money or post office accounts
required_documents: Application on prescribed Zakat form; Valid CNIC copy; Local Zakat Committee verification; Death certificate of spouse (for widows)
application_steps: Submit completed application to the Chairman of the Local Zakat Committee in applicant's union council or ward.

program_name: Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT) Free Specialized Healthcare
program_name_ur: ایس آئی یو ٹی مفت گردہ و یورولوجی علاج
implementing_agency: Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT) & Sindh Govt
target_beneficiary: All patients requiring dialysis, kidney transplant, liver transplant, urological surgeries, and oncology treatment
special_criteria: Open to all deserving patients regardless of race, religion, or background with zero charges ('Free Healthcare with Dignity')
benefits_coverage: 100% free lifelong hemodialysis, kidney transplants, organ immunosuppressive drugs, cancer chemotherapy, and surgeries
required_documents: Patient CNIC or B-Form; Medical history/referral documents; Attending guardian CNIC
application_steps: Walk into SIUT Karachi or regional outreach centers in Sukkur, Larkana; instant emergency triage and admission.

program_name: Sehat Card Plus Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
program_name_ur: صحت کارڈ پلس خیبر پختونخوا
implementing_agency: Health Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa & State Life
target_beneficiary: All permanent resident families of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (100% Universal Coverage)
special_criteria: Permanent address of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa registered on NADRA CNIC; family registered in NADRA civil database
benefits_coverage: Free cashless in-patient treatment up to PKR 1,000,000 per family per year covering secondary healthcare, cardiology, oncology, kidney transplant, neurosurgery, and intensive care across empanelled hospitals
required_documents: Original NADRA CNIC of patient; Child NADRA B-Form for patients under 18; Family Registration Certificate (FRC)
application_steps: Verify family eligibility by SMS (send 13-digit CNIC to 8500 or 9700) or online at sehatcardplus.gov.pk. Present CNIC at Sehat Card counter in any empanelled hospital.

program_name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Educational Endowment Fund (KPEEF) Scholarship
program_name_ur: خیبر پختونخوا ایجوکیشنل اینڈومنٹ فنڈ (کے پی ایف) اسکالرشپ
implementing_agency: Higher Education Department, Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
target_beneficiary: Underprivileged, talented students holding KP domicile studying in approved colleges and universities
special_criteria: KP domicile; passed Intermediate with minimum 60% marks; admitted on open merit in public institution
benefits_coverage: 100% tuition fee coverage + annual stipend towards hostel and educational expenses
required_documents: KPEEF Application Form; KP Domicile certificate; Intermediate result card; Father/Guardian income slip/affidavit; Fee receipt
application_steps: Apply through the Financial Aid Office / Focal Person of the enrolled college/university.

program_name: KP Merged Areas (Former FATA) Students Higher Education Scholarships
program_name_ur: فاٹا ضم شدہ اضلاع کے طلبہ کے لیے اعلیٰ تعلیمی اسکالرشپ
implementing_agency: Higher Education Department KP & Directorate of Merged Areas
target_beneficiary: Students belonging to merged tribal districts (Bajaur, Khyber, Kurram, Mohmand, Orakzai, North/South Waziristan)
special_criteria: Permanent domicile of erstwhile FATA tribal agencies/FRs; admitted in public universities across Pakistan on reserved seats
benefits_coverage: Full tuition fees + boarding charges + annual book stipend
required_documents: Domicile of Merged District; CNIC/B-Form; SSC/HSSC marks cards; University enrollment letter
application_steps: Apply through institutional financial aid desk or online via KP Higher Education portal.

program_name: KP-TEVTA Free Technical & Vocational Training
program_name_ur: کے پی ٹیوٹا مفت تکنیکی تربیت کورسز
implementing_agency: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Technical Education & Vocational Training Authority (KP-TEVTA)
target_beneficiary: Youth in KP seeking industry-standard technical training in computing, electrical, civil, mechanical, and hospitality
special_criteria: Resident of KP or merged districts; fulfilling academic prerequisites for chosen course
benefits_coverage: Free training + toolkits + trade certificate accredited by KP Trade Testing Board (TTB)
required_documents: CNIC/B-Form copy; School certificates; 2 photographs; KP domicile
application_steps: Apply online at kptevta.gov.pk or directly at regional Government Technical Training Centers (GTTC).

program_name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Workers Welfare Board Marriage Grant
program_name_ur: خیبر پختونخوا ورکرز ویلفیئر بورڈ شادی گرانٹ
implementing_agency: Workers Welfare Board (WWB) Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
target_beneficiary: Registered industrial workers in KP for the marriage of their daughters
special_criteria: Worker registered with KP Social Security (ESSI) or EOBI; at least 3 years service in industrial unit
benefits_coverage: One-time financial grant of PKR 400,000 per daughter
required_documents: Worker registration card; Employer certificate; Nikahnama; CNIC of worker and bride/groom
application_steps: Submit application through industrial employer to KP Workers Welfare Board in Peshawar.

program_name: Balochistan Educational Endowment Fund (BEEF) In-Province Scholarship
program_name_ur: بلوچستان ایجوکیشنل اینڈومنٹ فنڈ (بیف) انٹرا پراونشل اسکالرشپ
implementing_agency: Balochistan Educational Endowment Fund (BEEF)
target_beneficiary: Talented and deserving students holding Balochistan domicile enrolled in public colleges and universities in Balochistan
special_criteria: Balochistan Local/Domicile Certificate; minimum 60% marks in previous annual exam; regular student
benefits_coverage: Annual educational stipend ranging from PKR 30,000 to PKR 80,000 depending on degree level
required_documents: Local/Domicile certificate; Student CNIC/B-Form; Marks certificates; Institutional verification; Income certificate
application_steps: Submit BEEF application form through institutional scholarship committee in respective college/university.

program_name: BEEF Out-of-Province Premier Scholarships Scheme
program_name_ur: بیف آؤٹ آف پراونس پریمیئر اسکالرشپ اسکیم
implementing_agency: Balochistan Educational Endowment Fund (BEEF)
target_beneficiary: Balochistan students securing admissions on merit in top-ranked national universities outside Balochistan (LUMS, NUST, GIKI, IBA, AKU, FAST, etc.)
special_criteria: Balochistan Local/Domicile; secured admission on open merit in BEEF-designated Centers of Excellence outside Balochistan
benefits_coverage: 100% full tuition fee + hostel accommodation charges + monthly subsistence stipend
required_documents: Balochistan Local Certificate; University Admission Letter; Fee voucher; SSC & HSSC result cards; CNIC
application_steps: Apply directly through BEEF online portal or through the Financial Aid Office of partner top-tier universities.

program_name: Balochistan TEVTA Free Technical Education Courses
program_name_ur: بلوچستان ٹیوٹا مفت فنی تربیت
implementing_agency: Balochistan Technical Education and Vocational Training Authority (B-TEVTA)
target_beneficiary: Youth in Balochistan seeking technical trades in mining, heavy machinery, solar electrical, plumbing, and IT
special_criteria: Local resident of Balochistan; willingness to complete vocational certification
benefits_coverage: Free training + free hostel in selected institutes + stipend + recognized trade diploma
required_documents: Local/Domicile certificate; CNIC/B-Form; Educational marksheet; 2 photos
application_steps: Apply directly at regional technical training centers (TTC) in Quetta, Gwadar, Khuzdar, Loralai, Turbat.

program_name: Balochistan Zakat & Social Welfare Guzara Allowance
program_name_ur: بلوچستان زکوٰۃ گزارہ الاؤنس
implementing_agency: Zakat and Ushr Department, Government of Balochistan
target_beneficiary: Poor, destitute individuals, widows, and disabled persons across districts of Balochistan
special_criteria: Muslim; certified as Mustahiq by Local Zakat Committee (LZC); resident of Balochistan
benefits_coverage: Financial subsistence stipend of PKR 1,500 to PKR 2,000 per month
required_documents: Application on Zakat form; CNIC copy; Local Zakat Committee endorsement; Widow death cert (if applicable)
application_steps: Submit to the Chairman of the Local Zakat Committee in respective village/tehsil in Balochistan.

program_name: AJK Sehat Sahulat Program (Universal Health Coverage)
program_name_ur: صحت سہولت پروگرام آزاد جموں و کشمیر
implementing_agency: Department of Health AJK & State Life Insurance Corporation
target_beneficiary: 100% permanent resident families of all 10 districts of Azad Jammu & Kashmir
special_criteria: State Subject / AJK permanent address registered on NADRA CNIC; universal family entitlement
benefits_coverage: Cashless hospitalization coverage up to PKR 1,000,000 per family per year in empanelled hospitals across AJK and Pakistan
required_documents: Original NADRA CNIC with AJK address; B-Form for children; Family Registration Certificate (FRC)
application_steps: Check eligibility via SMS (send CNIC to 8500) and present CNIC at hospital Sehat Sahulat counter.

program_name: AJK Technical Education & Vocational Training Authority (TEVTA) Free Courses
program_name_ur: اے جے کے ٹیوٹا مفت فنی تربیتی کورسز
implementing_agency: AJK TEVTA, Government of AJK
target_beneficiary: Youth of Azad Kashmir seeking professional trades in IT, mechanical, electrical, tourism, and hospitality
special_criteria: State Subject of AJK; clearance of admission aptitude interview
benefits_coverage: Free tuition + toolkits + trade certificate accredited by National and AJK testing bodies
required_documents: State Subject Certificate; CNIC/B-Form; Educational certificates; 2 photographs
application_steps: Apply directly at vocational training centers in Muzaffarabad, Mirpur, Rawalakot, Kotli.
